eval_results.benchmark_answer: SELECT currency_name, short_plus_12m FROM (WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM mdp_dev.gold_analytics_gateway.monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= current_date()), countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', 'uk_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 'switzerland_3_month_interbank_rate', 'switzerland_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 'canada_3_month_interbank_rate', 'canada_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 'sweden_3_month_interbank_rate', 'sweden_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 'rba_cash_rate_target', 'australia_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 'new_zealand_3_month_interbank_rate', 'new_zealand_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 'china_3_month_interbank_rate', '-') AS countries(currency_code, currency_name, short_rate_code, long_rate_code)), series_values AS (SELECT rate_code, indicator_date, rate_value, two_hundred_day_average_value AS average_value, lag(rate_value, 252) OVER (PARTITION BY rate_code ORDER BY indicator_date) AS year_ago FROM mdp_dev.silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code LIKE concat('currency_value_%_in_', lower('AUD'))), today AS (SELECT v.* FROM series_values v JOIN asof a ON v.indicator_date = a.day), latest AS (SELECT i.rate_code, i.rate_value, i.observation_date FROM mdp_dev.silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i JOIN asof a ON i.indicator_date = a.day), ranked AS ( SELECT c.currency_code, c.currency_name, s.rate_value AS short_term_rate, s.observation_date AS short_term_date, l.rate_value AS ten_year_yield, CASE WHEN c.currency_code = upper('AUD') THEN 0 ELSE (t.rate_value / t.year_ago - 1) * 100 END AS currency_change_12m, CASE WHEN c.currency_code = upper('AUD') THEN 0 ELSE (t.rate_value / t.average_value - 1) * 100 END AS distance_from_average FROM countries c LEFT JOIN latest s ON s.rate_code = c.short_rate_code LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.rate_code = c.long_rate_code LEFT JOIN today t ON t.rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(c.currency_code), '_in_', lower('AUD')) WHERE s.rate_value IS NOT NULL AND (c.currency_code = upper('AUD') OR t.year_ago IS NOT NULL)) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY short_term_rate + currency_change_12m DESC) AS rank_position, currency_name, round(short_term_rate, 2) AS short_term_rate, short_term_date, round(ten_year_yield, 2) AS ten_year_yield, round(currency_change_12m, 1) AS currency_change_12m, round(distance_from_average, 1) AS distance_from_average, round(short_term_rate + currency_change_12m, 1) AS short_plus_12m FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_position) WHERE rank_position = 1
